description: Body proportions [BODY-01], torso, breast and leg shape, and hand and foot axes [BODY-02], each the weight of a named delta of the template; the skeleton follows through the joint regressor [MOD-07]. Posture rest offsets and nail shape are not registered yet: the specification names them without parameters.

defaults.provisional: No scan data yet [ID-07]: the axis is an authored delta and the value is its weight; +-3 (usual span +-2) is the conventional span of a standardised coefficient until the statistical model recalibrates it.

parameters.description: Lengthens the arms (upper arm and forearm) relative to the body; negative values shorten them.
Lengthens the legs relative to the trunk, raising the hips; negative values shorten them.
Broadens the shoulders and the shoulder girdle; negative values make them narrower and more sloping.
Widens the hips and pelvis; negative values narrow them.
Widens the palms and spreads the finger bases; negative values make the hands slender.
Lengthens all fingers relative to the palm; negative values make them shorter and stubbier.
Changes the relative lengths of the fingers: positive values lengthen the ring finger against the index finger, negative values the reverse.
Makes the knuckles and finger joints bonier and more prominent; negative values smooth them under softer tissue.
Lengthens the feet; negative values shorten them.
Widens the feet across the ball and toes; negative values narrow them.
Breast volume: positive values give fuller, rounder breasts with a full lower pole; negative values a flatter chest. Authored amount (no breast measurement in ANSUR II).
Breast shape: positive values project the central part of the breast further forward; negative values make it flatter and wider-based.
Breast shape: positive values lower the breast's lower pole and flatten the upper pole (ptosis); negative values lift the breast.
Breast shape: positive values set the breasts further apart; negative values bring them closer together.
Nipple size: positive values make the nipples larger and more protruding; negative values smaller and flatter.
Areola size: positive values widen the skin around the nipple and make it slightly puffier; negative values make it smaller.
Widens the waist; negative values narrow it. One unit is one standard deviation of ANSUR II waist breadth at the navel.
Buttock volume: positive values give fuller, rounder buttocks that project further back; negative values flatter ones. One unit is one standard deviation of ANSUR II buttock depth.
Fullness over the upper outer thigh below the hip bone; negative values make the side of the hips straighter or hollow. Authored amount.
Fuller thighs from the buttock fold to above the knee; negative values slimmer thighs. One unit is one standard deviation of ANSUR II thigh circumference.
